name: Renewals
description: The experience of renewing an existing insurance policy, from receiving the renewal notice through to confirming or adjusting coverage.

stages.name: Receive Renewal Notice
stages.description: Member receives email and/or letter notifying them their policy is due for renewal
actions: Click through to My Account or call
thoughts: How much will it cost this year?
Do I need to do anything?

painPoints.description: Renewal email doesn't show the new premium amount. Members have to log in to see the price, which many don't do until the renewal date passes.
The email CTA says 'View your renewal' but links to the My Account login page, not directly to the renewal details. Members who aren't logged in face an extra step.

opportunities.description: Include the new premium amount and the year-on-year change in the renewal email subject line and body
Deep link the email CTA directly to the renewal summary page, with authentication handled inline

stages.name: Review Renewal Details
stages.description: Member reviews the renewed policy details, premium changes, and coverage
thoughts: Why did my premium go up?
Is this still the right cover for me?
Can I get a better deal?

painPoints.description: No year-on-year comparison shown. Members can't see what changed between last year and this year without checking old documents.
No explanation of why the premium changed (claims history, market changes, property value adjustment). Members feel the increase is arbitrary.

opportunities.description: Show a side-by-side comparison of last year vs this year premium, excess, and coverage
Add a 'Why your premium changed' explanation with the contributing factors

stages.name: Adjust or Accept
stages.description: Member decides whether to accept the renewal as-is, adjust their coverage, or let it lapse
actions: Decide to accept, adjust, or leave
If adjusting: change excess, sum insured, or optional covers
thoughts: Can I reduce my premium by increasing excess?
What if I just let it lapse?

painPoints.description: There's no in-flow option to adjust cover at renewal. Members must call or start a new quote to change anything.
Auto-renewal happens by default. Some members don't realise they've been renewed until they see the charge on their bank statement.

opportunities.description: Allow members to adjust excess, sum insured, and optional covers online during the renewal window without starting a new quote
Send a clear reminder 7 days before auto-renewal with the premium amount and a one-click option to pause or cancel

insights.description: 18 support tickets in Q1 2026 were from members who didn't know their new premium until after auto-renewal charged their account.
22 support calls in Q4 2025 were members wanting to adjust their cover at renewal but finding no online option. Average call duration: 12 minutes.
6 of 8 participants in the February 2026 test said they felt the premium increase was 'unfair' or 'unexplained'. All 6 said a simple explanation would have made the increase acceptable.

changelog.description: Journey data published with full research findings, pain points, opportunities, and insights
